cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.text: Yes, I'll clean the hall. The policy lets senior volunteers supervise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Supervising the mop is covered.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who will hold it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Someone whose contribution isn't restricted by seniority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So what will you cook?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Does it mention cooking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who issues those?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Lend me your good tennis racket. I'd like my talent to have a fair surface.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you admit it helped?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll thank the strings. The strokes remain mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use your own racket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And let inferior equipment take credit for my defeat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.
